description: This file defines the ProductApi interface for network communication with a backend API related to products. It includes methods for retrieving product categories, listing products with filters, retrieving a specific product by ID, creating, updating, and deleting products. The API uses retrofit2 annotations for HTTP methods and URL paths.

classes.name: ProductApi
classes.description: Interface defining the product-related API endpoints using Retrofit annotations.

methods.name: getProductCategories
methods.description: Fetches a list of product categories available.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products with optional filtering and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product with the provided data.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product identified by its ID.
